Varied Selection, Tasty
Jan 2017 • Friends
I am not a vegetarian, and ate here twice with a Vietnamese friend because it was his "vegetarian day". Lunch was summer rolls, a young tofu soup, and rice fried with vegetables. The summer rolls were accompanied by a tasty peanut dipping sauce. I also enjoyed iced lemongrass juice. 

Dinner was braised mushrooms, steamed rice, braised broccoli.

All dishes were tasty and well prepared and arrived hot. I found portion size acceptable. The menu was extensive, and I could easily eat here again and again. 

On the (slightly) negative side, the operation seemed a little disorganized with some pages in my companion's menu not included in mine, and the dinner service was a little slow and one dish order had to be resubmitted. In fairness, this was the eve of Tet, and they were to close for several days after dinner service, and presumably were operating with skeleton staff. So that they had all that we ordered available is a positive. The atmosphere was calm and relaxed. Not frequenting such restaurants, I cannot comment on prices, but I felt we got value for price. 

Conveniently located across from Ben Thanh market. 

Recommended without reservation.

Of course the art work is not cheap but they are unique mostly featuring abstract scenes in vietnam.

We recently stopped by the Phung Mai (Art Cafe) Vegetarian Restaurant located on Phan Chu Trinh after reading some nice reviews here on TripAdvisor. Sadly, ours was a terrible experience which made us feel like we were being taken advantage of as tourists. 

To be fair the location of this restaurant is quite good, being right across the street from the Ben Thanh markets. We also liked the indoor seating area, the wall art decor and one of our two served dishes, the pandan fried rice was ok (rating 3 of 5). The rest of our experience was very, very poor. 

Staff were pleasant but made every mistake in the book during our lunch. Nearly a half hour after our original orders, we were informed that one of the dishes was no longer available. No problem, this happens all the time in SE Asia so we simply ordered another dish. 

Fifteen minutes later, staff returned to inform that our other original order wasn't available so we changed this as well. Yet again, a few minutes later, we were informed that our next round of selections were not available. 

We were then making our 5th and 6th selections some 45 minutes after our original orders. We basically had to choose what they pointed out as being available. Once food was served we were given one correct dish and one incorrect dish. Our heads were shaking in disbelief. 

Eventually, we had correct servings and could eat. As mentioned, the pandan fried rice dish was ok (see attached picture). Sadly, the curry dish they recommended to us was very poor (see attached picture). The curry was coconut base but bland in flavour and included a few veggie pieces that were mushy and tasteless. This was a very sad affair that neither of us could eat (rating 1 of 5). 

After the bad meal, we called it quits and skipped a dessert order. Then the next round of service issues ensued. When our check came, we were overcharged by two items, which they corrected without contestation. Later when we paid for the correct bill amount, we were short-changed by VND5000, which they again corrected. 

We walked out of the restaurant stupefied by what had just happened. We are both calm people but this place was seriously testing our patience. No restaurant makes this many mistakes on an accidental basis. We very much felt like Phuong Mai Vegetarian Restaurant was giving us the royal tourist treatment. As such, we would never dine at this eatery again and can't recommend to fellow TA members.
